book.name: 1 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Itoi kuhumii kwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga
Ngohe makalongo bhango, nipala umanye mbone kwa malobhe gha itoi kuhumii kwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Mmanye kubhehe, mmanyite jhe Chapanga, mukalongwichwe mundela yanganandela kuijhinamii inyagho yanga bhehe na ughome.

Bhahe, nipala umanye kubhehe mundo jhojhoha jwalongochwa na Uhuke gwa Chapanga ahoto kulonge, “Yecho alapanikile!” Helahela, abhii jhe mundo jhojhoha jwahoto kulonge, “Yecho ndi Bhambo,” pangalongochwa na Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Ibhii itoi yamahele, nambo Uhuke jwaibhoha ndi jhumo.
Ibhii ndela yamahele mukunhengela, nambo Bhambo jwatunhengela ndi jhumo.
Ibhii ndela yamahele mukuhenga lihengo, nambo Chapanga ndi jhumo jwenio jwahenga mahengo ghoha kwa bhando bhoha.
Chapanga iyekulila kila mundo kwa kwatangatila bhando bhoha.
Uhuke ampekii jhumo malobhe gha malango, na Uhuke jhojho ampekii jhonge uhotolo gwa kumanya ilebhe ngita champala jwenio Uhuke.
Uhuke jhojho ampekii mundo kihobholelo, na Uhuke jhojho ampekii kitoi cha kwalamicha bhibhalwalwa,

Uhuke gwa Chapanga ampekii jhonge uhotolo gwa kuhenga ikangacho, Uhuke jhojho ampekii jhonge uhotolo gwa kubhoha ulondole gwa Chapanga, na jhonge kulekanicha uhuke gwa Chapanga na yangabhehe ya Uhuke gwa Chapanga, jhonge alonge kwa lugha jhangamanyikana na jhonge kitoi cha kuchimulila chikilongelwa.
Lyenio lyoha ndi lihengo lya Uhuke jwenio jhumo, na jwenio imaghulila kila mundo kitoi ngita chapala jwenio.
Yegha jhimo nambo ihungo yamahele
Yegha ndi jhimo ipanginwe na ihungo yamahele, na pamonga ubhii na ilebhe yamahele, nambo ipangine yegha jhimo, yenio ndi chibhii kwa Kilichitu.
Nhwalo twenga tubatichwe kwa Uhuke ghumo tubhehe yegha jhimo, tubhehe Akayahude amu bhangabhehe Akayahude, tubhehe twakabhanda amu twakabhanda jhe, bhoha tunywelichwe Uhuke jhojho jhumo.
Yegha ipanginwe jhe na kihungo chimo, nambo ibhii ihungo yamahele.
Lukongono anda lulongela, “Nhwalo nenga nalubhoko jhe, bhahe nenga jwa yegha jhe,” bho, lukongono lubhehe lwa yegha jhe? Nahi jhe!
Anda lichikilo lilongile, “Nhwalo nenga jwa liho jhe, bhahe, nenga jwa yegha jhe,” bho, nhwalo lichikilo jwa yegha jhe? Nahi jhe!
Anda yegha jhoha ngaibhehe liho, nganyohine bho? Anda yegha jhoha ngaibhehe lichikilo, ngatunuite bho?
Nambo Chapanga abhekite kila ihungo kila chehemo mu yegha ngita chapahile.
Ngita ihungo yoha anda ngakibhehe kihungo chimo, bho, yegha ngaibhii koo?
Uchakaka ndi kubhehe, ibhii ihungo yamahele, nambo yegha ndi jhimo.
Bhahe, liho lihoto ndeka kunnobholela lubhoko, “Nimpahi jhe mwe.” Hilu muto uhoto jhe kughalobholela makongono, “Ngwete malola na magholo.”
Nambo kupeta gheniya, kubhehe ihungo yenio ya yegha ibhonekana kubhehe ileghelike, yenio ndi ipalwa hake.
Kabhele ihungo hela tulonge kubhehe yanganandela, ndi ibhekwa mbone hake, na ihungo ibhonekana yambone jhe tuighubikila mbone.
Nambo ihungo ibhonekana yambone hake, ipalwa jhe kulolekewa mbone. Chapanga jwenio abhekite yenio yegha, na chikipela utopaho chela chikiponokiwa,
kupala kwangabhehe jhe na mpechangano payegha, nambo ipagwa yoha itangatilane.
Anda kihungo chimo kilwalwa, bhahe, ipagwa yoha ilwalwa pamonga na chenie, anda kihungo chimo kilombwitwe, ihungo yoha ihangana pamonga na chenie.
Bhahe, mangota mabhoha ndi yegha jha Kilichitu, kila jhumo ndi kihungo cha yegha jhenie.

Mu lilongo lya bhando bhubhajheketii Kilichitu, hote Chapanga abhekite akatenga na jwa ubhele milondole bha Chapanga na jwa utato bhabhola na jwa ncheche bhala bhubhatenda ikangacho, bhala bhubhapekiwe makakala gha kwalamicha bhibhalwalwa, na bhubhahoto kwatangatii bhando bhange, peniya ilongoche na bhubhalonge lugha jhangamanyikana.
Bho, bhando bhoha ndi akatenga? Bho, bhando bhoha ndi milondole bha Chapanga? Bho, bhando bhoha ndi bhabhola? Bho, bhando bhoha bhakwete kitoi cha kuhenga ikangacho?
Bho, bhando bhoha bhakwete kitoi cha kulamicha bhando? Bho, bhando bhoha bhakwete kitoi cha kulonge lugha jhangamanyikana? Bho, bhoha bhichimulila lugha jhibhalongela?
Yene mwipale hake itoi ibhii ikolongwa. Na nenga ngohe chaninangiya ndela jha mbone hake kupeta yoha.
